description_ru: Автор убеждает, что учить английский трудно, но полезно, и делится советами.
text:
Learning a language is difficult, but I believe it is worth the effort. I started English two years ago, and my life is already different.

First, English helps me at work. Last month, a customer from Canada called our office. Nobody wanted to answer, but I took the phone and spoke to him. My boss was surprised and very pleased.

Second, I can enjoy films and songs without translation. At first, I understood only a few words. Now I understand much more, and it feels great.

Third, English opens the door to the world. When I travel, I can ask for directions, order food and make new friends.

My advice is simple. Do not wait for the perfect moment. Study a little every day, and speak aloud, even when you make mistakes. Mistakes are normal. Everybody makes them, and they help you learn.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Поставьте кончик языка между зубами и выдохните без голоса; не заменяйте звук на «с» или «ф».
Округлите губы, как для «у», и быстро переходите к гласному; зубов не касайтесь.
Нижняя губа слегка касается верхних зубов, звук звонкий; не превращайте «v» в русское «в» двумя губами.
Долгий звук между «э» и «ё», губы расслаблены, язык в центре рта.

questions.question: How long has the writer studied English?
What is the writer's advice?
questions.answer: Study a little every day and speak aloud.
